checks.name: endpoints
checks.evidence: Upload, job, detail, retry, cancel and diagnostic routes are declared.

checks.name: role_permissions
checks.evidence: All Content Manager routes reject viewer and guest roles.

checks.name: tenant_scoped_resource_access
checks.evidence: Routes resolve authorized scope and resource SQL constrains organization/workspace/project.

checks.name: state_machine_transition_validation
checks.evidence: One canonical graph rejects skipped, repeated and terminal transitions.

checks.name: exclusive_claim_and_lease
checks.evidence: Atomic claim, worker ownership, lease and heartbeat persistence are implemented.

checks.name: abandoned_job_recovery
checks.evidence: Expired untouched claims requeue; partial attempts fail closed for review.

checks.name: duplicate_policy
checks.evidence: Exact duplicates are rejected before job creation.

checks.name: idempotent_concurrent_job_creation
checks.evidence: A partial unique index and atomic conflict handling protect active jobs.

checks.name: manifest_schema
checks.evidence: Attempts and exact resource IDs have normalized persistent tables.

checks.name: real_ingestion_orchestration
checks.evidence: A document-agnostic PyMuPDF4LLM page-first pipeline is wired to the durable worker.

checks.name: job_summary_and_reconciliation
checks.evidence: Reconciliation compares manifest PG resources with attempt-keyed isolated vectors.

checks.name: temporary_and_compensating_cleanup
checks.evidence: Cleanup is manifest/document bounded, Milvus-first, audited and idempotent.

checks.name: configurable_limits
checks.evidence: Upload and worker limits are typed in core/config.py.

checks.name: isolated_write_e2e
checks.evidence: Write validation is default-off, DEV-only, fixture-hash constrained and routed to an isolated scope/collection.
